Personally I think it's redundant just because all controllers with touchpads (Dualshock 4, Dualsense, Steam Deck, are there other controllers with touchpads?) are already supported and their touchpad support doesn't really rely on the controller being in the controller database (they're already there, and touchpad support requires special handling and packet sending with HIDAPI) :D
If more controllers with touchpads appear (like the new Steam Controller), just adding the controller to the controller database isn't enough, it requires HIDAPI reading/writing stuff

I think that makes sense! More generally, if someone doesn't bother to specify which touchpad they want to use, I think it's reasonable to assume that they want *the* touchpad they must believe exists for the device.
`p_value` here is `p_position` in the header
Thanks for catching that, I should be able to fix it today!
